findings.what: A delete on a running shield can skip the current-chat check.
findings.why: currentChats is filled asynchronously. If it is unset or stale, this branch can delete the chat that pi is using without first sending new_session. That can lose the active chat file.
findings.fix: Route every delete on a running shield through AgentsTab. Read pi's current state at action time, send new_session if it holds the chat, then delete.

message: The map fixes, canonical drop confirms, attach tokens, persistent tabs, and rail menus follow the plan. One chat-delete path still risks data loss because it trusts a cached current chat. Use the fresh pi state check for every delete while the shield runs. I attempted all three gates, but this read-only workspace denied writes to Vite and Cargo cache files; the implementation report records them as passing.
